extDescription.message: Keeps a local log of who viewed your LinkedIn profile. Read-only, once a day, inside your own browser.

popupSub.message: Read automatically from LinkedIn, once a day.

warnGapTitle.message: Some viewers may have been missed.

warnGapBody.message: Click Read now to complete the list.

emptyRecentBody.message: Open LinkedIn and click Read now for the first read.

emptyReturningBody.message: People who view your profile more than once show up here.

emptyAnonymousBody.message: Viewers in semi-private mode show up only with a job title or a company.

optionsSub.message: The extension only reads your own list of profile viewers. It never clicks, sends messages or visits profiles.

optWindowHint.message: The exact time is picked at random inside this window every day. If LinkedIn is not open within 3 hours of that time, the read happens anyway in a background tab.

optEndpoint.message: HTTPS endpoint that receives new viewers

optDestHint.message: Without an endpoint the list stays in this browser and leaves only through Export CSV. When you save an endpoint, Chrome asks for permission to reach that origin.

secAbout.message: What it does and what it does not do

about1.message: Opens the “Who viewed your profile” page once a day in a background tab, reads it and closes it.

about2.message: Stores name, headline, connection degree and roughly when each person viewed your profile.

about3.message: Never stores passwords or cookies. Nothing leaves the browser except the list sent to the endpoint above, if you set one.

about4.message: People browsing in private mode never appear: LinkedIn does not show them to anyone.

about5.message: Automated reading of LinkedIn pages goes against the LinkedIn User Agreement. You run it at your own risk, on your own account.

msgNeedHttps.message: The address must start with https.

msgNoPermission.message: Without that permission the extension cannot send to this address.

msgNoEndpoint.message: $COUNT$ pending, but no endpoint is set.

msgRejected.message: The endpoint rejected the request ($STATUS$). Pending items stay in the queue.
